change_summary: Increase memory limit from 512Mi to 2Gi for order-service pods to resolve recurring OOMKill events
diff_or_config:
# k8s/order-service/deployment.yaml
spec:
  containers:
  - name: order-service
    resources:
      requests:
-       memory: 256Mi
+       memory: 1Gi
      limits:
-       memory: 512Mi
+       memory: 2Gi
        cpu: 500m
service_context: order-service (Go), 12 pods across 3 AZs, EKS cluster prod-us-east-1. Current node pool: m5.2xlarge (32Gi each).
deployment_plan: Rolling update with maxSurge=1 maxUnavailable=0. Pods replaced one at a time over ~15 minutes.
observability_evidence: Grafana dashboard: grafana.internal/d/order-svc-resources showing memory usage trends and OOMKill count.
alerting_evidence: PagerDuty alert 'order-service-oomkill' fires when OOMKill count > 2 in 5m window. Alert has fired 14 times this week.
blast_radius: order-service only. Node memory utilization will increase from 68% to ~74% per node.
validation_evidence: Load test in staging with 2Gi limit showed 0 OOMKills under 2x production traffic for 4 hours.

seeded_gaps.description: No rollback plan if increased memory causes node resource pressure or scheduling failures
No SLO or reliability impact assessment provided
No owner or on-call team identified for the change
